name: ps-stdlib-snapshot-limits
body: Limit — The stdlib/alias/type tables are a fixed PowerShell 7.6.0 all-platform-union snapshot: not diffed against 7.6.6, the PSResourceGet 1.2.0 branch/gallery tag is assumed rather than verified, and no table is checked against a live `pwsh`. Upgrade — Re-fetch from the PowerShell repository at the new tag, diff the accelerator table mechanically (not by eye), and add a `Get-Command`/`TypeAccelerators::Get` dump comparison.
